target: Scenarios become data files run by one runner that writes each run as a result directory, a check(run) judge separates engine invariants from model behavior rates, and an aigent CLI runs or checks a directory with exit codes that say what kind of trouble a run had.

questions.prompt: What problem does this change solve for the people who use it?

options.label: It stops a failure that people hit before the change.
It renames parts of the code and keeps the old behavior.
It makes the tool faster and changes nothing people can see.

key_points: the failure people hit before the change

questions.prompt: What does this change make harder, and why was that cost worth it?
key_points: why the gain is worth more than the loss

questions.prompt: Which part of the old behavior does the change keep, and what does that protect?
key_points: the behavior that stays the same

questions.prompt: Where would a mistake in this change show up first, and who would notice it?
key_points: the first place the mistake shows
